Power table uses SEs implied by recorded 95% intervals of acquisition_program_20261018 (2,304 compounds, 686 families) and 1/sqrt(n) scaling; the factorial interaction assumes 2x the highest paired SE with independent arms (conservative). Not the registered threshold derivation.
L1000 qualification matches by 13-character Broad id and normalised cell name; structure/salt identity unchecked. Only metadata tables were read.
Baselines are simplifications (batch-EIG, PS-BAX-style); papers read at abstract level only. Batch-EIG is outcome-independent in the Gaussian model.
ENHANCEMENT.md is subagent model output; NOVELTY_REVIEW.md records the repository cross-check (overlap with Block N, 9-line vs single-line translator input) and the decision not to start Stage 1.

Stage 0 recount (labels + fingerprints only): 136 eligible families after the within-family Tanimoto 0.5 split; STAGE0_CONTRACT.md is a draft with [OPEN] items; nothing frozen, no LLM call.
